name: Floating Icon Dropdown
description: Select dropdown with an icon and label trigger. The menu opens below, and a floating icon chip follows the cursor over a sliding highlight row.
contents: Trigger button showing the selected option icon, label and rotating chevron
Dropdown panel listing options with staggered fade in
Cursor-following icon chip and sliding row highlight
behavior: Click the trigger to open or close, selecting an option updates the trigger and closes the menu
Clicking anywhere outside closes the menu
On hover the real cursor is hidden and an icon chip follows the pointer while a highlight slides between rows

props.name: channels
props.default: 5 social channels (linkedin, instagram, facebook, twitter, youtube)

editableByProps: Options list with keys, labels and 16x16 SVG icon paths
Initially selected option and menu width
Surface, border, accent, text, hover and chip colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Show the normal cursor instead of the icon chip
needsCodeEdit.where: cursor-none class on the option button

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
A window click listener closes the menu while it is open and is removed on close and unmount.
The cursor-following chip needs a mouse, on touch the rows still work by tapping.
